simple.meaning: מִקְטָר (miqṭâr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “something to fume (incense) on i.e. a hearth place.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.short: something to fume (incense) on i.e. a hearth place
definitions.full: H4729. miqtar [ מִקְטָר מַקְטֵר, ] noun masculine place of sacrificial smoke ; — construct קְטֹדֶת מִקְטַר מִוְבֵּחַ Exod 30:1 altar, place of offering incense (SS Kau Buhl 13 and others noun active burning ).

occurrences.englishText: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.
